display_long_description:
**How2 Series Pumpers** is the first and only VR simulator built specifically for Meta Quest featuring both **Aerial Ops** with a 100-foot mid-mount platform and advanced pump modeling with fluid dynamics based on real-world fire apparatus.

Master the aerial pedestal, tackle high-volume rooftop suppression, or coordinate multi-unit water supply in our **Relay Co-op** pumping mode with integrated live voice chat.
[media]

# 🔥 Highlights

**Risk-Free Practice:** Master pump ops, aerial setup, outrigger short-jacking, and ladder placement without the risk of live burns or million-dollar apparatus damage.

[media]

**Immersive Training:** 360° environments, lifelike rigs, cab-to-turntable sequences, and authentic fireground conditions.

**Train Anytime:** Access repeatable, on-demand scenarios from anywhere.

**Save Costs:** Reduce wear-and-tear on expensive rigs while cutting fuel and staffing expenses.

[media]

**Realism Meets Readiness:** Practice pressure, flow, hydrants, hydraulics, relay pumping, spatial awareness, and aerial master stream operations.

**Boost Engagement:** Interactive sim training and dynamic telemetry enhance learning and retention.

Includes:

– **Aerial Ops:** 100-ft platform, pedestal controls, outrigger setup, **TrueClimb™** mechanics, rooftop streams

– **Pump Ops:** flow, pressure, friction loss, water movement, relay operations

– **Water Supply:** hydrants, drafting, hose/nozzle selection & line deployment

– **Mixed Reality (MR) Mode:** train in your own physical space

[media]
🚒 Pumpers for Quest puts the fireground in your headset—no turnout gear required.
